text:
violet: opened a compact migration guide PR for v1->v2: param rename (model -> model_id) and embed dim change. Need a tiny rollback-safe snippet and one-line smoke tests.

dan: paste before/after curl examples?

violet: v1:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"Hi"}'
```
v2:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/complete -d '{"model_id":"redwood-small-v2","input":"Hi"}'
```

ramey: add a one-liner probe for embed dim and a tiny Python shim. Probe:
```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -d '{"model_id":"embed-lite-v2","input":"x"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding|length'
```
Python shim:
```python
def norm(p):
  if 'model_id' in p: return p
  if 'model' in p: p['model_id']=p.pop('model')
  return p
```
